title: Lake Champlain Community Sailing Center

services.name: 1pm Sails
services.desc: At the Community Sailing Center, everyone is invited to sail regardless of age, income, or ability. That’s why we offer so many different camps, classes, and programs to teach the sport of sailing and help new sailors feel confident enjoying their time on the water. Half- and full-day options grouped by age and ability make learning to sail fun, safe, and full of new friends. Camps start at age 6 and include sailing-only or multi-activity options. Now is a great time to pick up a sport you’ve always wanted to try! A variety of boats, sessions, and class times make it easy to fit into your schedule.
